en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a Central European riverside town. In the foreground is a metal truss bridge on stone piers crossing a broad river with embankment walls. Behind the bridge stands a compact town of 19th‑century multi‑story masonry buildings and villas on a slope, with a prominent institutional building on the right and a squarish tower or church in the middle distance. The background shows gently rolling hills, fields, and a distant solitary tower or windmill on the ridge. No visible caption or text appears on the image.
